content: Render free web services spin down after 15 minutes with no inbound HTTP request or WebSocket message; the next request/connection wakes it in about one minute. Active WebSocket traffic (i.e., a game actually being played) counts as inbound traffic and keeps the service awake, so the sleep risk is confined to idle periods before the host starts the party. 750 free instance-hours/month, effectively one always-on free service.
